products.name: REL Slave - 973mm x 1295mm (Eurocontainer)
description: The REL Master is a durable Eurocontainer that prevents water ingress with its overlapping pair. Its nestable design makes it perfect for cost-effective freight, and its patented CCE lock ensures security. With 2 moulded-in handles and 3 extra-strong hinges, this container is built to last. The interlocking hinges and 5 ribs provide optimal strength.
Overlapping watertight pair of lids to fit 2.5 & 5 cubic metre Euro containers.
